The available corpus provides limited but specific evidence regarding **Inter Hospital Variation**, focusing entirely on disparities in regional pain management protocols. Specifically, the data highlights that there is a significant difference between hospitals in terms of offering pain treatment with an [[epidural]] catheter [^src1]. This variation in clinical practice and patient access to care is noted in connection with [[amager-og-hvidovre-hospital|Amager og Hvidovre Hospital]] and [[naestved-slagese-og-ringsted-sygehuse|Næstved, Slagelse og Ringsted sygehuse]] [^src1]. 

Because the dataset contains only a single claim on this subject, no further details, chronological events, or broader statistical contexts regarding the exact nature or extent of this variation are currently available.

## Claims

- Der er stor forskel mellem sygehusene i forhold til at tilbyde smertebehandling med epiduralkateter [^src1]
